title: Intermediate Hatha Yoga
description: A balanced Hatha yoga class for practitioners with some experience. This class builds on foundational poses and introduces more challenging variations, deeper stretches, and longer holds. Focus on refining alignment and developing strength and flexibility.
requirements: Ability to hold poses for 3-5 breaths
Please inform the instructor of any injuries or health concerns
cancellationPolicy: Cancel up to 2 hours before class
